sources.title: doth4580/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-EXL3-3.68bpw · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Original model: Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next by the Qwen team. This repository holds quantized (modified) weights of it; the original model card follows this one, verbatim. Start ./gb10_inference --node --port 29500 on each of the three other machines, then on the head: ./gb10_inference --server ...

sources.title: doth4580/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-DotH-MTP-MXFP8 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A retrained multi-token-prediction (MTP) head for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next. The MTP head is the small drafter that speculative decoding uses to propose the next few tokens; the full model checks every proposal. This head has the same architecture, tensor names and shapes as the stock head. Only its dense layers were retrained, on Flash-Next's own outputs; the 512 routed experts are the original ones ...
